custom_steps:
1. In tab 1, open [WO-1] and leave the page open.
  2. In tab 2, open [WO-1], click the Finance tab and click Create Invoice so the work order is Invoiced. Leave the New Customer Payment window that opens as it is: do not pay and do not close it (closing it with its X takes the invoice back off and the work order returns to Complete).
  3. In tab 1, without reloading, click Lead Technician on the status card.
  4. Pick [Tech-B].
  5. Read the message that appears and the Lead Technician field.
  6. Reload tab 1 and read Lead Technician.
